new_candidates.date_enacted: 2026-07-27 (Town Council public hearing and approval by voice vote at its regular meeting)
new_candidates.duration: One year upon passage, or as otherwise provided by the Town Council by ordinance; effective immediately upon passage
new_candidates.legal_basis: Town of Westerly ordinance 'AN ORDINANCE IMPOSING A ONE-YEAR MORATORIUM ON ALL DATA CENTERS,' adding a new Data Center Moratorium section to the Westerly Code of Ordinances; noticed for public hearing 2026-07-27, adopted the same night by voice vote
new_candidates.trigger: Town's ordinances and zoning regulations are silent on data centers; officials anticipate data center applications given the town's undeveloped land near water bodies and wanted time to draft siting/zoning rules before any application could vest
new_candidates.current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. The Westerly Town Council adopted a one-year moratorium on all data centers by voice vote at its July 27, 2026 meeting after a public hearing at which no one spoke in opposition. The ordinance bars the Planning Board, Zoning Board of Review, Zoning Board of Appeal, and all town agencies/employees from accepting, processing, approving, denying, or otherwise acting on any non-vested application, plan, permit, or license for a data center for one year from passage (through approximately 2027-07-27), with a vesting exemption for applications already certified complete.
new_candidates.affected_projects: None named; the town manager told the council the ordinances are 'currently silent on data centers' and the pause is meant to give the zoning side time to draft rules before any application could vest.
new_candidates.outcome: Adopted by voice vote after a public hearing at the July 27, 2026 regular Town Council meeting; no recorded opposition.

evidence.title: Town of Westerly Proposed Ordinance: An Ordinance Imposing a One-Year Moratorium on All Data Centers (public hearing notice, published July 18, 2026)
evidence.publisher: Town of Westerly, Rhode Island (Town Clerk)
evidence.supports: Full text of the proposed moratorium ordinance, including findings, one-year duration, effective-upon-passage clause, vesting exemption, and the July 27, 2026 public hearing date.
evidence.quote: The moratorium shall last for one year upon passage or as may be otherwise provided by the Town Council by ordinance. ... a data center moratorium is hereby adopted imposing a moratorium on all data centers, which shall be effective immediately upon passage.

evidence.title: Westerly Council Adopts One-Year Data Center Moratorium, Sends Four Charter Questions to November Ballot
evidence.supports: Confirms the ordinance was adopted (not merely proposed) by voice vote at the July 27, 2026 meeting, that no one spoke against it, and the stated purpose of giving the zoning side time to draft data center siting rules.
evidence.quote: The council opened a public hearing and then approved an ordinance imposing a one-year moratorium on all data centers. ... No one spoke against the moratorium. Councilors approved the ordinance by voice vote after closing the hearing.

new_candidates.notes: Distinct from Smithfield, Charlestown, Cumberland, and Lincoln, RI, which enacted permanent zoning bans on data centers (not time-limited moratoria) and so are not recorded here as new moratorium candidates. A widely indexed 'Newport town council passes data center moratorium' story is about Newport, North Carolina (Carteret County), not Newport, Rhode Island; no Rhode Island Newport action was found and it is excluded.
